# T2.05c: picture setup contents (in progress, stuck)

## What the error is

- RM's error notifier is set **~1.08 s after the doorbell**, every time: 256x128, 1920x1088, 64x64 and 16x16 alike.
  That's a timeout, not an immediate fault.
- Status buffer: `error_status` 1, `ucode_error_status` 0 (raw words `0 1 0 0 3 0 …`). The class error codes are
  `ApptimerExpired` = 1, `InvalidInput` = 2, `HwerrInterrupt` = 3. The microcode's buffer checks (T2.05b) give
  `error_status` 2 with a code, so `error_status` 1 reads as "app timer expired". **The encode hardware starts and
  never finishes.** The microcode gives up after its timer and returns the error to RM (RC 47).
- No MMU fault, nothing written to bitstream, recon (not set at all in the `upto=7` run), or any of the 14 extra
  buffers (incl. `IO_DEBUG_STATUS`).

## Tried, no change (all still time out after ~1.08 s)

| Area | Variants (`NVENC_VAR=…`) |
|---|---|
| Timers | `gpton` (GPTIMER_ON), `gptimer=0xffffffff`, `wd=0xffffffff` (SET_WATCHDOG_TIMER), `cycles` |
| Pipeline stages | `meonly` (SET_CONTROL_PARAMS ME_ONLY + me_only_mode), `ipcm` (force IPCM), `nodeblock`, `cabac`, `pictype=0/2` (P, I) |
| Frame size | 16x16, 64x64, 256x128, 1920x1088 |
| Input surface | `intile` (tiled 16x16), `inbl=1/2` (Tegra / naive BL), `bh=0/2/4`, `inbhf=0/2`, input in vidmem (`vid`, `allvid`) |
| Picture control | `rows` (slice_encoding_row_num = MB rows), `strips` (strips_in_frame 1), `maxbytes`, `maxslice`, `qpfifo`, `codec=1..4`, `sliceauto`, `noref`, `toplevel`, `nofout` |
| ME control | `hints` (hint_type0..4 = 0..4; the doc says they must cover 0x1f), `mbc=1/16` |
| RC | `rc` (sequence-level values instead of zeros) |
| Buffers | `NVENC_MINBUF=1` (no extra buffers), `upto=7..24` |
| Magic | `NVENC_MAGIC=0x12345678`, `0xC8B70006` |

Structure sizes match the header (`nvenc_h264_drv_pic_setup_s` 512 B, slice 128, ME 192, MD 128, quant 192, picture
control 276, RC 88; checked with the compiler on the dev VM). The control offsets 512/640/832/960 are right.

## Where that leaves it

Since a 16x16 ME-only picture stalls the same way, the cause is probably not in the encode settings. Something more
basic is missing or wrong for the hardware (as opposed to the microcode's DMA, which works: it reads the setup and
writes status). Candidates nvenc_drv.h doesn't answer:
1. memory attributes the hardware needs (PTE kind / caching / page size) that the falcon's own DMA doesn't care about;
2. a buffer or method the hardware path needs that has no doc text on Ada (e.g. `SET_UCODE_STATE`, which
   `clc9b7.h` lists at method offset 0x000, a host-method slot, while Turing's `clc5b7.h` has it at 0x50C);
3. a field in the setup that must be non-zero for the hardware to start, among the many undocumented ones.

A reference point would shorten this a lot: what a working NVENC client on this same driver programs. See the
question in the session (observing nullmoth's library at its RM/IOKit boundary without disassembly) before T2.05c
continues.
